accounts.name: signer
docs: The guardian or the admin; pays the record's rent (about 0.0022 SOL) and gets it back on
removal.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The user or a relayer; pays the rent of the destination's USDC account if it is missing.

accounts.name: destination_usdc
docs: handler); created here when missing.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent for the 64 bytes this deposit adds to the epoch account.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Owns `source`; recorded as the depositor, the only signer who can refund this leaf.

accounts.name: config
docs: Writable: the deposit counts towards `net_deposits` (deposit cap).

accounts.name: blocked
docs: unless the guardian listed that address; the deposit is refused when it holds a record.
Last, so clients that pass it also work with a gateway built before it (extra accounts are
ignored there).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the express epoch's rent (about 0.002 SOL).

accounts.name: authority
docs: Owns `source`; recorded as the depositor.

accounts.name: blocked
docs: unless the guardian listed that address; the deposit is refused when it holds a record.
Last, so clients that pass it also work with a gateway built before it (extra accounts are
ignored there).

accounts.name: solver
docs: Pays the destination, the Front rent and, if missing, the destination's USDC account.

accounts.name: payee_usdc
docs: Where `claim_exit` repays the solver: any USDC account but the gateway's own.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Pays the Front rent and, if missing, the destination's USDC account; gets the rent back.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Becomes the admin. Must be the program's upgrade authority, so nobody can front-run
initialization and choose the portal that receives every batch (ADR 0010).

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Escrow: owned by the config PDA. Only `send_batch` and `refund_deposit` sign for it.

accounts.name: fee_vault
docs: Fee vault (ADR 0012): owned by the config PDA. Only `send_batch` (pays the fees out) and
`refund_deposit` (gives a fee back) sign for it.

accounts.name: exit_authority
docs: every exit and owns exit custody.

accounts.name: exit_custody
docs: Exit custody (ADR 0009): owned by the exit authority. CCTP pays exits in (`receive_exit`);
only `claim_exit` signs for it.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: The treasury named in the params: it must already be a USDC token account.

accounts.name: epoch
docs: program can allocate data at this PDA, so non-empty data means it is already open.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Relayer: pays the `ExitBatch` rent and CCTP's used-nonce rent.

accounts.name: exit_batch
docs: Created here; its seeds come from the message's hook (`exit_message::batch_seed_*`).

accounts.name: cctp_message_transmitter
docs: enabled attesters and threshold.

accounts.name: cctp_remote_token_messenger
docs: the only accepted sender.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The deposit's `authority`; receives the freed rent.

accounts.name: config
docs: Writable: the refund frees room under the deposit cap (`net_deposits`).

accounts.name: destination
docs: Any USDC account the depositor owns.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Finisher; pays the CCTP MessageSent rent (~0.0042 SOL, reclaimable after 5 days) and
receives the finisher share of the batch's fees.

accounts.name: finisher_usdc
docs: The finisher's USDC account: the finisher share is paid here.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: cannot receive USDC (closed, frozen, another mint), its share goes to the finisher instead,
so a treasury problem never blocks a batch (`treasury_can_receive`).

accounts.name: message_sent_event_data
docs: Fresh keypair; CCTP's MessageTransmitter creates the MessageSent account here.

types.name: AddressAdded
docs: An address can no longer deposit, effective at once.

types.name: AddressRemoved
docs: The address can deposit again.

types.name: BatchFeesPaid
docs: Emitted by `send_batch`: the batch's fees left the fee vault (ADR 0012). `finisher` and
`treasury` are the USDC token accounts paid. `treasury_skipped`: the treasury account could
not receive (closed, frozen, not USDC), so its share went to the finisher instead.

types.name: BatchSent
docs: Emitted by `send_batch`. `hook` is the exact 51-byte CCTP hook (ADR 0002).

types.name: BlockedAddress
docs: PDA ["blocked", address]: `address` cannot be the `authority` of a deposit while this exists.
Added at once by the guardian or admin; removed by `unblock` once an announced removal is due.

fields.name: list
docs: LIST_SANCTIONS, LIST_STOLEN_FUNDS or LIST_OTHER.

fields.name: reference
docs: Free-form pointer to the public source of the entry (scripts/screening: sha256 of the
source record, e.g. "ofac-sdn:feature:94579").

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Paid the rent; gets it back when the entry is removed.

fields.name: unblock_eta
docs: 0 = no removal announced; otherwise `unblock` works from this time.

fields.name: escrow
docs: Principal of deposits that have not crossed. Only send_batch and refund_deposit move it.

fields.name: fee_vault
docs: Fees of deposits that have not crossed (ADR 0012). Only send_batch (pays them out) and
refund_deposit (gives them back) move it.

fields.name: exit_custody
docs: Exit custody (ADR 0009): CCTP pays exit batches in here; only `claim_exit` pays out of it.
A token account at PDA ["exit_custody"] owned by the exit authority PDA ["exit_authority"],
which is also every exit message's destinationCaller.

fields.name: portal
docs: Ethereum portal as a CCTP bytes32 (12 zero bytes + address): mint_recipient and
destination_caller of every batch. Fixed at initialization.

fields.name: denominations
docs: USDC base units; 0 = unused slot. Fixed at initialization in Phase 0.

fields.name: current_epoch
docs: Id of the open epoch per denomination.

fields.name: net_deposits
docs: Principal that has entered and not been refunded: + denomination per deposit,
- denomination per refund. Bounded by `params.deposit_cap` (ADR 0012).

fields.name: pause_cooldown_until
docs: The guardian cannot pause again before this time (ADR 0010).

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step admin transfer: proposed by the admin, accepted by this key.

fields.name: fee
docs: The fee paid at deposit, returned with the denomination.

fields.name: fee
docs: Paid on top of the denomination into the fee vault (ADR 0012).

types.name: Epoch
docs: One epoch of one denomination. Grows by one leaf per deposit (depositor pays the rent);
once closed it is the batch record: leaves stay readable so anyone can build Merkle paths.
`depositors[i]` signed the deposit of `leaves[i]`; only they can refund it (ADR 0010). It is
the transaction signer, which is public anyway.

fields.name: root
docs: Batch root; meaningful once status != Open.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: `params.fee_bps` and `params.finisher_bps` when the epoch opened: every deposit, payout
and refund of this epoch uses them, so a fee change applies from the next epoch (ADR 0012).

types.name: ExitBatch
docs: One exit batch (ADR 0009): an Aztec exit epoch of one denomination that crossed through CCTP.
`receive_exit` creates it, with exactly `count x denomination` in exit custody; `claim_exit`
pays each leaf once. PDA ["exit_batch", denomination_index, exit_epoch_id (u64 LE)], so a
second message for the same exit epoch can never be received.

fields.name: root
docs: Root of the exit tree: leaves `Poseidon(dest_hi, dest_lo, secret)`, batch node hash,
depth 8 (ADR 0004).

fields.name: count
docs: Exits in the batch, leaves 0..count.

fields.name: claimed_count
docs: Exits paid so far.

fields.name: claimed
docs: Bit `i % 8` of byte `i / 8` is set once leaf `i` is paid.

fields.name: cctp_nonce
docs: The CCTP nonce of the message that carried the batch.

types.name: ExitClaimed
docs: Emitted by `claim_exit`: leaf `leaf_index` of an exit batch paid one denomination to
`destination`'s USDC account (ADR 0009).

types.name: ExitFronted
docs: Emitted by `front_exit` and `front_exit_from_pool` (ADR 0017).

types.name: ExitReceived
docs: Emitted by `receive_exit`: an exit batch arrived through CCTP and its root is stored
(ADR 0009). `amount` = count x denomination, now in exit custody.

types.name: ExpressDeposited
docs: Emitted by `deposit_express` (ADR 0015). The express epoch is closed at once with this one
leaf; `express_id` has EXPRESS_EPOCH_BIT set. `paid_by_pool`: the crossing pool paid
`express_fee`, otherwise the user did. `send_express_batch` then emits the usual `BatchSent`
and `BatchFeesPaid` with this id (the bit is the express flag).

types.name: ExpressEpoch
docs: One express crossing (ADR 0015): a batch of one leaf, closed when it is made, sent by
`send_express_batch`. PDA ["express", denomination index, express id (u64 LE)].

fields.name: express_id
docs: With EXPRESS_EPOCH_BIT set: the epoch id of the batch hook.

fields.name: status
docs: Closed (ready to send) or Sent.

fields.name: root
docs: Root of the one-leaf tree (depth 8, ADR 0004).

fields.name: fee
docs: The ADR 0012 fee and its finisher share, at the params of the deposit.

fields.name: express_fee
docs: The express fee, paid to the finisher at send (ADR 0015).

fields.name: paid_by_pool
docs: The crossing pool paid `express_fee` ("on us"); otherwise the user did.

types.name: Front
docs: One fronted exit (ADR 0017): someone paid the destination early and is repaid by `claim_exit`.
PDA ["front", leaf], so a leaf is fronted at most once and `claim_exit` always finds it.

fields.name: exit_epoch_id
docs: The exit epoch the fronter named (informational: the leaf is what binds).

fields.name: advanced
docs: What the destination received: denomination − fee.

fields.name: payee
docs: USDC account `claim_exit` pays the whole denomination to.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Gets the record's rent back when it closes.

fields.name: from_pool
docs: Paid from the liquidity pool (payee = the pool's vault).

fields.name: written_off
docs: A pool front no longer counted in the share price (`write_off_front`).

types.name: FrontRepaid
docs: Emitted by `claim_exit` for a fronted leaf: the whole denomination went to the fronter.

fields.name: portal
docs: Ethereum portal address, left-padded to 32 bytes (ADR 0002).

fields.name: denominations
docs: Strictly increasing, non-zero, 1..=MAX_DENOMINATIONS entries (USDC base units).

fields.name: params
docs: Includes the fee, its finisher share, the deposit cap and the treasury (ADR 0012).

fields.name: admin_lifetime_secs
docs: Admin sunset, seconds from now (<= MAX_ADMIN_LIFETIME_SECS).

types.name: LaneParams
docs: The V2 parameters, each inside a hard bound (constants.rs). Changes are timelocked like
`Params`: 14 days when a fee rate changes (`front_fee_cap_bps`, `pool_fee_bps`), 7 days
otherwise. Turning pool fronts off (`disable_pool_fronts`) is immediate.

fields.name: express_fee
docs: What an express crossing pays the finisher who sends it (USDC base units), from the
crossing pool while it holds at least this much, else from the user (ADR 0015).

fields.name: front_fee_cap_bps
docs: The most any front may keep from an exit, in basis points of the denomination (ADR 0017).

fields.name: pool_fee_bps
docs: What a front paid from the liquidity pool keeps (<= front_fee_cap_bps). Fixed, so every
pool payout of a denomination is the same amount.

fields.name: pool_max_outstanding
docs: Bound on what the pool has advanced and not been repaid (USDC base units).

fields.name: keeper
docs: The key that signs pool fronts after checking the exit on Aztec. `Pubkey::default()` turns
pool fronts off.

types.name: Lanes
docs: PDA ["lanes"]: created once by `init_lanes`. Its existence is what turns the V2 instructions on.

fields.name: crossing_pool
docs: USDC account at PDA ["crossing_pool"], owned by the config PDA (ADR 0015).

fields.name: express_next
docs: Next express counter per denomination (the id is `EXPRESS_EPOCH_BIT | counter`).

fields.name: pool_paid
docs: Express fees the crossing pool has paid so far (public, for the app's "on us").

types.name: Liquidity
docs: PDA ["liquidity"]: the pool that funds fronts (ADR 0017, amended). Accounting is internal, so
a token transfer straight to the vault changes nothing:
assets = liquid + outstanding; a share is worth (assets + V) / (shares + V).

fields.name: vault
docs: USDC account at PDA ["liquidity_vault"], owned by this PDA.

fields.name: liquid
docs: Idle USDC in the vault that belongs to the pool: what can be fronted or withdrawn.

fields.name: outstanding
docs: Advanced by pool fronts, not yet repaid nor written off.

fields.name: fees_earned
docs: Front fees realized at repayment: the only source of share price growth.

fields.name: written_off
docs: Advanced amounts written off, and what came back later for written-off fronts.

types.name: LpPosition
docs: PDA ["lp", owner]: one liquidity provider's shares.

types.name: Params
docs: Tunable parameters, each inside a hard bound (constants.rs). Changes are timelocked.

fields.name: per_epoch_cap
docs: Max deposits per (epoch, denomination); raise-only; <= MAX_BATCH_LEAVES.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: User fee on each note, paid on top of the denomination; <= FEE_CAP_BPS (ADR 0012).
Each epoch snapshots it when it opens.

fields.name: finisher_bps
docs: The part of `fee_bps` paid to whoever sends the batch; <= fee_bps. The rest goes to
`treasury`. Snapshotted per epoch with `fee_bps`.

fields.name: deposit_cap
docs: Bound on the principal that has entered and not been refunded (`Config::net_deposits`),
in USDC base units; raise-only.

fields.name: treasury
docs: USDC token account that receives the rest of each batch's fees at `send_batch`.

fields.name: eta
docs: Unix timestamp after which `apply_params` may execute.

types.name: Screening
docs: PDA ["screening"]: created once by `init_screening`; counts the entries.

fields.name: blocked
docs: Entries in force now (added and not removed).

types.name: UnblockProposed
docs: The removal of an address is announced; anyone can carry it out from `eta`.
